**Source of truth:** `packages/operator-core/lib/sync/pot-git/gate/hermeticity.ts`
(the machine-readable registry + classifier; this page is the narrative). Audit:
2026-07-02, plan `cross-machine-coord-parity-and-trust-2026-07-01` P-049.

## The model

A gate **shard** is one `(workspace, unit|integration)` pair (`gate/shards.ts`,
DG-2). Verdicts are keyed by `(shardId, inputsHash)` — so a shard must produce
the **same verdict from `(stagingSha, shard)` on any capable machine**. That is
hermeticity, and it is the property the whole distributed gate rests on.

## What a machine must offer (`shardCapabilities`)

- **unit shard** → `node` (a runtime + an `npm ci`'d checkout at the sha).
- **integration shard** → `node` + `docker` (testcontainers Postgres/redis/
  typesense; images pullable or pre-pulled). All four integration workspaces
  (`apps/operator`, `packages/operator-core`, `libs/papercusp/libs/db`,
  `libs/test-config`) ride `@papercusp/test-config` — throwaway per-run DBs,
  never a host Postgres.

## Why the suites are hermetic by design

- `test-config/src/setup-hermetic-env.ts` scrubs spawn-env pollution (workspace
  pins, git-config injection, release-gate roots, PGBOUNCER class-defaults) and
  redirects state-dir seams (`PAPERCUSP_*_DIR`) off the real `~/.papercusp`.
- Live-operator suites **probe and self-skip** (`it.skipIf(!live)`,
  reachability → `describe.skip`, or an explicit env opt-in). Their verdict
  stays valid everywhere; only live coverage narrows. The audited list lives in
  `KNOWN_COVERAGE_COUPLINGS` — add rows only with the guard line in hand.
- The admin test-runs reporter's dev-DSN fallback is fail-soft (1s timeout →
  null): on a foreign machine it reports nothing and fails nothing. The gate's
  own verdict facts (DG-1 `gate/verdicts.ts`) are the cross-machine record.

## The class that was fixed (don't reintroduce it)

Five suites read migration DDL through hand-rolled `../../..` candidate lists
with a **hardcoded dev-box absolute path** as last resort (one pointed at a
path that existed on no machine at all). Fixed 2026-07-02 with
`readRepoFile(__dirname, 'libs/papercusp/libs/db/sql/…')` from
`@papercusp/test-config` — a walk-up resolver that is depth-, dist- and
machine-proof and **throws loudly** instead of falling back. Use it for ANY
repo-relative file a test reads. Never write an absolute checkout path in a
test.

## What the gate does NOT cover (loud boundary)

`GATE_COVERAGE_BOUNDARY`: Playwright e2e, Cargo tests, LLM scenarios — they run
on their own rails. `green(S)` means *all npm-workspace shards passed*, not
*all testing passed*.
